proof: ci.yml:15-19 wraps the bare `npm test` command (not npm install) in nick-fields/retry with max_attempts: 3. Any single test run that fails non-deterministically gets up to two silent re-runs before the job is marked failed, and CI never surfaces that a retry occurred. This applies to the whole suite, not a scoped flaky test, so genuine intermittent failures are indistinguishable from a clean pass in the workflow's final status.
checked: retry scope (whole command vs single test)

proof: package.json:8 sets jest coverageThreshold to 80% lines, but package.json:5's test script is plain `jest` with no --coverage flag, and ci.yml:19 invokes `npm test` (same plain script).
